solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Brat wrecked bit of ski resort's equipment

indicators.note: something wrecked is broken up, so the four letters of the word brat are rearranged

explanation.surface: A spoilt child smashes up some of the lifts at a ski resort.
explanation.definitionFit: A drag lift with a bar shaped like the letter, used to tow skiers uphill, is standard kit at a ski resort.

clue.text: Odd United Nations part of programme cut short

indicators.note: cut short means the last letter of the word is lopped off

parts.note: an event is one item on a programme of sports or entertainment

explanation.surface: An odd item in a United Nations schedule gets curtailed.
explanation.definitionFit: Odd and uneven are synonyms for numbers not divisible by two, and also for things irregular.

clue.text: Just a travelling show

definitions.meaning: just here is the adjective meaning equitable or even-handed
a funfair that moves from town to town with rides and stalls

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both even-handed and a touring funfair, two unrelated senses of one spelling.

clue.text: A boy, ten, helped out? That's totally unacceptable

indicators.note: out signals that the letters of the preceding words are put out of order and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a ten-year-old lad helped out, and another person condemns it as outrageous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'helped out' reads as a phrase, but 'out' is the anagram signal on A BOY TEN HELPED.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes conduct outside the bounds of acceptable behaviour, the pale being a historic boundary.

clue.text: Restricted in hut, needing source of light

parts.note: a shack is a crude hut
an LED (light-emitting diode) is a source of light

explanation.surface: Someone is confined in a hut and needs a lamp.
explanation.definitionFit: Shackled means bound or fettered, hence restricted in movement or freedom.

clue.text: Second-rate group of workers? That can be painful

parts.note: B grade is second rate, after A
a trade union is an organised group of workers

explanation.surface: A shoddy trade union, the clue jokes, can be a pain.
explanation.definitionFit: A bunion is a swelling on the joint of the big toe, which is often sore.

clue.text: Fail to find top of mountain: give false impression?

parts.note: to miss something is to fail to find or hit it
the peak is a mountain's summit

explanation.surface: A climber who cannot find the summit perhaps misleads others about it.
explanation.definitionFit: To misspeak is to say something wrongly, so conveying a mistaken impression.

clue.text: Spy facing time in servitude

parts.note: James Bond is the fictional spy
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A secret agent faces a long stretch in slavery.
explanation.definitionFit: Bondage is the state of being a slave or serf, the same as servitude.

clue.text: Beautiful woman, one appearing after 60 minutes

indicators.note: appearing after places the numeral for one behind the period of sixty minutes

parts.note: sixty minutes make an hour
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A lovely woman turns up an hour late.
explanation.definitionFit: In Islamic tradition a houri is a beautiful maiden of paradise, so by extension any lovely woman.

clue.text: Flowing water I have discovered in middle of burrow

indicators.note: discovered in says the contraction is found sitting inside the other letters
middle of takes the central pair of letters of burrow

parts.note: I've is the contraction of I have

explanation.surface: Someone finds water running through the heart of an animal's burrow.
explanation.definitionFit: A river is a natural stream of water flowing in a channel.

clue.text: Flowering plants Doris arranged around church

indicators.note: around says the scrambled name surrounds the abbreviation for church
arranged means the letters of the name Doris are set in a new order

explanation.surface: Doris does the flower arrangements in church.
explanation.walkthrough: Doris looks like the flower arranger, but 'arranged' scrambles her name into ORIDS, and 'around' wraps that about church's abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Orchids are a large family of flowering plants prized for their showy blooms.

clue.text: Formal account worker's written about artists retrospectively

indicators.note: has written about says the worker's letters are wrapped around what follows

parts.note: a hand is a manual worker; the 's stands for has

indicators.note: retrospectively means looking backwards, so the abbreviation is reversed

parts.note: RAs are Royal Academicians, i.e. artists

explanation.surface: A worker has compiled an official record about artists looking back on their careers.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of worker's stands for has; Royal Academicians are the usual crossword artists, and 'retrospectively' turns them round to SAR before 'written about' wraps the worker round them.
explanation.definitionFit: Hansard is the official verbatim record of debates in the UK Parliament.

clue.text: Going back to base, we do harm, becoming drunk

indicators.note: drunk suggests staggering about, so the letters of we do harm are jumbled

explanation.surface: A rowdy group confess they cause trouble as they get drunk on the way home.
explanation.definitionFit: Heading towards home, one's base, is travelling in that direction.

clue.text: A party in German's capital can be embarrassing

parts.note: a bash is a party

indicators.note: capital means the leading letter of the word German

explanation.surface: Throwing a party in Berlin, Germany's capital, could prove embarrassing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'German's capital' suggests Berlin, but it is only the letter G.
explanation.definitionFit: To abash is to make someone feel ashamed or awkward, so abashing is a synonym of embarrassing.

clue.text: Sudden movement in bar — nothing spilt!

indicators.note: spilt means the zero letter is knocked out and lost from the word

parts.note: a lounge bar is one room of a British pub
O is the zero digit, nothing

explanation.surface: Someone lurches in a pub without spilling a drop.
explanation.walkthrough: A LOUNGE is the more comfortable bar in a British pub.
explanation.definitionFit: A lunge is a sudden forward thrust of the body, as in fencing.

clue.text: Drink tea sitting beside Maureen

indicators.note: sitting beside says the two pieces are placed next to each other

parts.note: Mo is a short form of the name Maureen
cha (or char) is British slang for tea

explanation.surface: Someone drinks tea while sitting next to Maureen.
explanation.definitionFit: Mocha is a coffee drink, often flavoured with chocolate.

clue.text: Hug little son weighed down by worries

indicators.note: in a down entry, weighed down by puts the son's letter beneath the worries

parts.note: cares are worries
S is the abbreviation for son, as in genealogies

explanation.surface: A parent hugs a small son who is burdened by troubles.
explanation.definitionFit: A caress is a gentle, affectionate touch or embrace, close to a hug.

clue.text: Fish dad cooked in white wine

indicators.note: in places the rearranged letters inside the wine

parts.note: hock is a white wine from the Rhine

indicators.note: cooked means the letters of dad are worked over and rearranged

explanation.surface: Father cooks fish in a white wine sauce.
explanation.walkthrough: Hock is a German white wine from the Rhine; 'cooked' scrambles dad and 'in' places the result inside the wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Haddock is an edible sea fish of the cod family.

clue.text: Not on, having diamonds in the workplace?

parts.note: off is the opposite of on
ice is slang for diamonds

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether wearing diamonds at work is not on.
explanation.definitionFit: An office is a room or building where people do their jobs.

clue.text: Dispute about vessel used for church service?

indicators.note: about means turned round, so the quarrel word is read backwards

parts.note: a row is a quarrel or dispute
a ship is a sea-going vessel

explanation.surface: An argument breaks out over a boat being used for a church service.
explanation.definitionFit: Worship is the act of religious devotion, as in a church service.

clue.text: Female in ascendant movement up to now

indicators.note: in says the abbreviation for female sits inside the upward movement word

parts.note: to soar is to rise up high

explanation.surface: A woman is rising in a movement that has prospered until now.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means until the present time, i.e. hitherto.

clue.text: Twenty, about to be dismissed, becoming resentful

indicators.note: to be dismissed says the abbreviation for about is sent away from the number word

parts.note: a score is twenty
C (circa) is the abbreviation for about

explanation.surface: Someone aged twenty, about to be sacked, grows bitter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about to be dismissed' reads as a phrase, but 'about' gives C, which is removed.
explanation.definitionFit: Being sore about something is feeling aggrieved or bitter, a colloquial sense of resentful.

clue.text: Part to go round audibly

indicators.note: audibly means the word is heard rather than read, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: to roll is to turn over and over, going round

explanation.surface: An actor's part requires going round making a noise.
explanation.definitionFit: A role is a part played by an actor.

clue.text: Rinse out something sticky

indicators.note: out means the letters of rinse are put out of their order

explanation.surface: Instructions to rinse away something sticky.
explanation.definitionFit: Resin is a gummy substance exuded by trees such as pines.

clue.text: I cry, all stirred up and emotional

indicators.note: stirred up means mixed around, so the letters of the phrase are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone weeps, all worked up and overcome with feeling.
explanation.definitionFit: Lyrical means expressing strong feelings effusively, as in waxing lyrical.
